field.label: Export Square Foot Prices
field.comment: Replaces price values in Amasty CSV feed exports with the calculated square foot price. Products without square foot data always keep their original price. This is a global setting read from the default scope.

field.label: Whitelisted Parent SKUs
field.comment: Comma separated configurable parent SKUs. Only children of these products export square foot prices.

field.label: Fill unit_pricing_measure Column
field.comment: Writes the square foot area covered by the row price (for example 7.5sqft) into the feed column mapped to the target attribute, so Google can display a per square foot price next to the real price. The column is always emptied for products out of scope. Takes effect only when the feed profile contains a column mapped to the target attribute.

field.label: Whitelisted Parent SKUs
field.comment: Comma separated configurable parent SKUs. Only children of these products get the measure value.

field.label: Target Feed Attribute
field.comment: The Amasty feed attribute key of the column reserved for unit_pricing_measure, in the internal group|code format. The feed profile column must be mapped to this attribute.
